hero.heading: Where kellyofficesolutions.com stands, and what it is worth to fix
hero.intro: Every number here came from a Semrush or Firecrawl pull or from the live HTML of the site. Where a pull was not made, the table says so. This is the baseline the engagement is measured against at 30, 60 and 90 days.
tiles: organic visits a month, 91 percent landing on the home page
top-10 results for copier lease winston salem, the headquarters city
Authority Score, level with Copiers Plus at 24 and above Titan at 19

findings.title: Absent from every top-10 result for copier lease in the headquarters city
findings.evidence: For copier lease winston salem the ten results are RJ Young, Copier Lease Center, Novatech, Hartford Rents, Sharp's own branch page, Office Equipment Now, Titan's Winston-Salem page, 360Connect, 1800 Office Solutions and Copier Specialists of the Triad. Kelly has no Winston-Salem page; the headquarters is a paragraph on the contact page.
findings.cost: The home market's copier buyers, and every AI answer built from these results, go to national lessors and to Titan, a Charlotte competitor that built a page for Winston-Salem.
findings.fix: A Winston-Salem location page with LocalBusiness, Service and FAQPage schema, the Sharp dealer relationship stated, and the copier pages linked from it. It is in the build.

findings.title: The site is a phone book for people who already know the name
findings.evidence: The five brand spellings (kelly office solutions, kelly's office, kelly office, kelly solutions, kellysolutions) bring about 80 percent of visits; kelly office solutions alone is 49 percent. The home page earns 473 of 518 monthly visits. Copier lease (2,400 searches a month), managed print services (4,400) and office coffee service (2,900) have no Kelly page in the top 100.
findings.cost: Every new customer has to arrive already knowing Kelly. Search and AI assistants have nothing to send a stranger to.
findings.fix: Fifty-five pages, each built around one thing a buyer asks, with the service area in the title and a FAQ marked up on every page.

findings.title: Sharp's own branch pages outrank the Sharp dealer
findings.evidence: business.sharpusa.com/branches/winston-salem is number 5 for copier lease winston salem and business.sharpusa.com/branches/raleigh is number 1 for copier dealer raleigh nc sharp, with Gray and Creech at 2 as a Sharp dealer in Central NC. Kelly is absent from both, although Sharp is its first brand and the Raleigh branch page ranks for 11 keywords and earns no visits.
findings.cost: Buyers who already want a Sharp are sent to Sharp direct or to a competing dealer.
findings.fix: Brand and product pages that name Kelly as the local Sharp dealer by model family, Sharp first in every brand list, and a listing on Sharp's dealer locator in the 90-day plan.

findings.title: No LocalBusiness, FAQPage or Service schema on any of 178 pages
findings.evidence: Every page carries the same Yoast Organization and WebSite block. Five offices and zero LocalBusiness records. Zero FAQPage. The 69 pages with any other schema are blog posts with Yoast's Article block. Competitors: Copiers Plus carries FAQPage on its managed print page; Vision Office Systems carries OfficeEquipmentStore, a LocalBusiness type.
findings.cost: An answer engine cannot tie Kelly to Winston-Salem, Greensboro, Charlotte, Raleigh or Swansboro, and has no question-and-answer text to lift into an answer.
findings.fix: Organization plus the headquarters LocalBusiness on every page, a LocalBusiness per office on the location pages, Service schema on every service, industry and product page, FAQPage on all 55. In the build.

findings.title: One contact page does all the non-brand work
findings.evidence: /contact-us/charlotte/ ranks for 68 keywords: copiers charlotte number 1, copier companies in charlotte nc 3, office equipment company charlotte 3, copier lease charlotte nc 8. The Greensboro page ranks for 15 keywords and the Raleigh page for 11, and both earn zero visits. Winston-Salem has no page at all.
findings.cost: Four of five markets have no page an engine can match to a local copier or print query.
findings.fix: Five location pages, each with its address, hours, LocalBusiness record, the services that branch delivers and a local FAQ. The Charlotte page's terms carry across with a redirect.

findings.title: The brand reviews result shows employer ratings and a one-star Yelp, not customers
findings.evidence: For kelly office solutions reviews: Indeed 3.1 from 8 employee reviews at 1, Facebook 3.9 (6 reviews) at 2, Glassdoor 3.9 at 4, Yelp Greensboro 1.0 from 2 reviews at 6. No Google Business Profile appears in the top ten, although Google reviews are embedded on the Charlotte page and the home page states an NPS of 94.4 percent. BBB A+ accredited profile at 9.
findings.cost: A prospect checking the name sees a 3.1 and a 1.0 before any customer proof.
findings.fix: Claim and complete the Google Business Profile for all five offices, ask for a Google review when every service ticket closes, and add Review schema only when real reviews exist. Answer the two Yelp reviews.

findings.title: A quarter of the sitemap is archives and a theme demo
findings.evidence: 45 of 178 URLs are tag, category, author and newsletter archives, with tags that are whole sentences (a-disaster-occurs-somewhere-in-the-world-almost-daily). 26 more are leftover theme pages: about-me, basic-data-entry, diary-management, my-services, travel-arrangements, sample-page, form-test, about-kelly-2, old-privacy-policy. An author archive exposes the agency's account name.
findings.cost: Crawl budget on pages that say nothing, and a personal-assistant theme demo indexed under the Kelly name.
findings.fix: Retire all 71 with permanent redirects to the nearest real page. The redirect map is generated from the sitemap and is in the download.

findings.title: The blog is filed in the wrong drawers and signed by admin
findings.evidence: 70 posts since 2020, about one a month, median 644 words, 63 with Article schema. 51 are authored by admin. Fourteen sit in /uncategorized/ and cyber security posts sit under /water-purification-system/. The best post, the business printer guide, earns 12 visits a month.
findings.cost: Consistent publishing that engines cannot attribute to a person or a topic, so none of it builds authority for the service pages.
findings.fix: Move the posts to /blog/ under the seven service lines, a named author with Person schema, an answer sentence under each H1 and a FAQ per post. The redirect map carries every post.

findings.title: The home page title names no service and no city
findings.evidence: Title is Kelly Office Solutions - Since 1947 (35 characters); the meta description ends with the company email address; the H1 is Moving Business Forward Since 1947. The page carries 91 percent of the site's traffic.
findings.cost: The strongest page on the site does not say what Kelly sells or where.
findings.fix: Retitled to name copiers, managed print and IT with North Carolina, a description written for a buyer, and a FAQ marked up on the home page. In the build.

findings.title: The managed print and copier pages carry no city, no FAQ and no schema
findings.evidence: /managed-print-services/ has 1,713 words and ranks 6 for managed print services charlotte nc (70 a month) with no city in its title; managed print services (4,400, difficulty 16) and copier lease (2,400, difficulty 19) have no Kelly page in the top 100. Copiers Plus's managed print page carries FAQPage and earns the Greensboro result.
findings.cost: The deepest pages on the site rank on the fringe of one city and nowhere nationally.
findings.fix: Service pages retitled with the service area, a FAQ and Service schema on each, and a managed print cost guide aimed at the question terms. In the build.

findings.title: robots.txt asks every crawler to wait ten seconds
findings.evidence: Crawl-delay: 10 at the top of robots.txt. Google ignores the directive; Bing and most AI crawlers honour it, so 178 URLs take half an hour to recrawl. AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended) are otherwise allowed. No llms.txt.
findings.cost: Slower discovery of every change, on the engines that feed Copilot and other assistants.
findings.fix: Remove the delay, keep AI crawlers open, add an llms.txt. Day one of the plan.

findings.title: Question keywords have no home on the site
findings.evidence: How much does it cost to lease a copy machine (260 a month), is it better to buy or lease a copier (110), what is managed print services (320), what is document management (720). Posts touch the topics without a question heading or FAQ schema.
findings.cost: AI Overviews and chat answers pull these definitions from competitors' blogs.
findings.fix: FAQ blocks on every page and the copier lease-versus-buy and managed print cost guides in the build; two more guides a month in the plan.

findings.title: Forms are Contact Form 7 beside a HubSpot tracking script
findings.evidence: The pages load the HubSpot tracking script and Google Tag Manager, but the request, supplies and meter-read forms are Contact Form 7. A submission is an email, not a contact record.
findings.cost: A lead from the site cannot be followed through the CRM or attributed to the page that produced it.
findings.fix: Every form in the build becomes a HubSpot form that creates a contact and records the source page.

compare.verdict: Kelly has the authority, level with Copiers Plus and above Titan and Vision, and the most words per page. What it lacks is pages: no Winston-Salem page, no FAQ anywhere, no LocalBusiness for five offices. Titan wins Kelly's home city with one subdomain page; Copiers Plus wins Greensboro with a location page and a FAQ. The gap is structure, not links.

moves.body: The brand reviews result is an Indeed 3.1 and a Yelp 1.0. Claim the Google Business Profile for every office, ask for a review when each ticket closes, show the real reviews on the location pages, and add Review schema only when they exist.

blog.heading: Seventy posts since 2020, filed in the wrong drawers
blog.intro: Every post in the sitemap, parsed the same way as the pages. Publishing is steady; attribution and structure are not.
tiles: posts in the sitemap; about one a month since 2020
posts with Article schema and a date (Yoast), 51 of them authored by admin
posts in /uncategorized/; cyber security posts filed under /water-purification-system/
found: Cadence is the asset. Roughly one post a month for six years is more than any Triad or Charlotte dealer publishes.
Nothing tells an engine who wrote them. Fifty-one posts are by admin; the two named authors are the agency writer and the marketing director, without Person schema or an author page.
The category is the URL. A cyber security post at /water-purification-system/cyber-security-brings-peace-of-mind tells a crawler the topic is water.
Titles already ask the questions buyers type (how to sanitize a water cooler, what is network management). The first paragraph rarely answers in one sentence, so nothing is lifted into an AI answer.
The business printer guide is the site's best non-brand page at 12 visits a month. That is what the rest of the blog could do with structure.

entity.heading: What connects the company across the web
entity.intro: Answer engines corroborate a company across the web before they name it. Kelly's profiles exist and are active; the site connects only three of them and none to the five offices.
tiles: BBB accredited, and the BBB profile links to the site
Instagram followers with 602 posts; Facebook 3.9 from 6 reviews; LinkedIn company page active
sameAs links in the Organization schema today (LinkedIn, Facebook, X); no Instagram, BBB or Google profile
LocalBusiness records for five offices; the Google reviews on the Charlotte page are not marked up
found: The Organization schema carries name, URL and logo and points to LinkedIn, Facebook and X. It has no address, no founding date, no phone and no link to the BBB profile that Google already shows for the brand.
The Wake Forest athletics (godeacs.com) and Winston-Salem Dash (milb.com) sponsorships are the strongest local links Kelly has, and neither is mentioned on the site.

No Google Business Profile appeared in the brand reviews result. For a five-office dealer, the profiles, their Q&A and their reviews are the largest local answer-engine input, and they are not fed from the site.
The customer portal at meters.kellyofficesolutions.com is indexed as Login: Central. It should not be in the index at all.
The old site's tagline, the NPS of 94.4 percent and the 1947 founding date are the facts assistants repeat about Kelly. They should be on one page, marked up, with sources.
